title: Activity bar icons: five options each for Board, Artifacts and Knowledge
description: Fifteen icon candidates drawn in lap's style (one 2px round stroke on 24×24), each shown large and at its real 24px size beside lap's icon, with what it means, what it takes from lap and how it could be misread. Click one per view to build a lineup; a recommended set and an all-spiral set are shown for comparison.
